sql=SELECT NOW(6) AS checked_at; SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COALESCE(SUM(status='SUCCESS'),0) AS success_count FROM participation_history WHERE campaign_id=85; SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_sequence_groups FROM (SELECT sequence FROM participation_history WHERE campaign_id=85 GROUP BY sequence HAVING COUNT(*)>1) t; SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_user_groups FROM (SELECT user_id FROM participation_history WHERE campaign_id=85 GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) t;
